description: Searches VertoDigital's full case-study library (mostly B2B technology clients in cybersecurity, data platforms, FinTech, GTM SaaS, cloud infrastructure and more, plus consumer services brands in lending and education) and returns the matching lines as markdown, with section headings kept for context. Each match carries a case-studies/<slug> link to pass to vertodigital_get_page for the full write-up. Use it to find a specific client, or every result in an industry or channel; for a short, curated set of flagship proof points tied to a buyer's challenge, use vertodigital_get_value_proposition with aspect: "proof_points" instead. query is matched line by line as a case-insensitive substring, not ranked full-text search, so a single keyword ("LinkedIn") finds more than a phrase ("LinkedIn ads for fintech"); omit it for the whole library (roughly 10 KB). Fetched live from the case-studies page on every call.

query.description: One keyword: client name, industry, service, or outcome. Examples: "cybersecurity", "LinkedIn", "SnapLogic", "pipeline", "SEO". Omit to return the full list of case studies.

name: vertodigital_search_case_studies

markdown.description: The document as markdown - identical to the text content block.

query.description: The filter keyword that was applied, or null for the full list
